title: Best AI Video Generators for Facebook Ads in 2026: 7 Compared
summary: The best AI video generators for Facebook and Instagram ads in 2026: 7 tools compared by job, free plan and price, plus Meta's own video ad specs.
body_markdown:
## How do you choose an AI video generator for Facebook ads?


Start from where the ad runs, then decide who or what is on screen, plan the opening, and count what each new version costs; in Flick, the shots on the canvas and each cut on the timeline live in one project.


1.


### 1


Start from the placement


Feed, Stories and Reels each want their own shape, so check that the tool makes or resizes to 4:5 and 9:16 before you write a word.


2.


### 2


Pick who is on screen


A presenter talking to camera, your product on its own and a short scene with characters each point to a different tool, so start from the ad you would shoot.


3.


### 3


Plan the opening


The first seconds decide whether anyone stays, so make several openings for one ad and keep the rest of the cut the same; in Flick, ask the agent for new opening shots and swap them in on the timeline.


4.


### 4


Price each version


Credits run out per second of video, per ad or per generation, so price the number of versions you will test in a month, retakes included.
